HOW TO USE

THE 30-SECOND VERSION
  1. Pick your map and artillery type at the top.
  2. Click where your gun is on the map.
  3. Click your target.
  4. Dial in the Azimuth and Mil it gives you.

That's the whole tool. The rest is extra.

1 · Pick map and weapon

Range rings and firing solutions change per weapon, so set this first.

L81 MortarSPH-2
Range132–684 m780–2,629 m
ArcsOneLow and High

2 · Place your gun

Click once where your gun actually is. You get a yellow crosshair plus range rings — inside the inner ring is too close, outside the outer ring is too far.

The SPH-2 also gets a dashed ring at 1,181 m. Inside that, only the HIGH arc works.

3 · Place your target

Click again where you want the shells to land. The tool switches from gun to target automatically, so two clicks is all it takes.

Drag either marker to adjust — numbers update live. To re-place one deliberately, press ⌖ GUN or ✕ TARGET above the map first.

4 · Read the solution

  • DISTANCE — meters. This is your RNG number.
  • AZIMUTH — compass bearing. Traverse the tube to this.
  • MIL — elevation to dial in.

In game: enter the mortar (E), traverse until the compass matches the azimuth, set the RNG/mil, then fire one ranging shell.

COPY FIRE MISSION copies it all as text for squad chat.

5 · Mark the Control Zone

Press ◎ CZ, then click where the zone is this match. You get a true-scale circle you can drag. Press ◎ CZ again to remove it.

With the CZ and your range rings both showing, you can see whether a firing position covers the zone before you build there.

6 · Fix a miss

Firing tables assume flat ground, and the maps aren't flat — uphill lands short, downhill lands long. Fire one shell, watch it land, then correct:

  1. Pick SHORT or LONG, type the meters off.
  2. Pick LEFT or RIGHT, type the sideways error.
  3. Press CORRECT — you get a corrected azimuth and mil.

7 · Save targets

Place a target, type a name in SAVED TARGETS, press SAVE. Click any saved target later to instantly re-aim at it. Press ✕ to delete one.

8 · Mark enemies

Right-click the map (phone: press and hold) to open the marker menu — tanks, APCs, infantry, artillery, helis, FOBs, LZs, supply, danger. Each uses the game's own icon.

To remove one: right-click or hold on it → REMOVE MARKER.

9 · New match

Press RESET MAP, then again to confirm. Clears gun, target, CZ and enemy markers. Saved targets stay.

ActionPCPhone

☀ slider brightens dark terrain. TOPO/TERRAIN switches to contour lines — useful for seeing whether your target is uphill or downhill.

Worth knowing

  • Always fire one ranging shell first. One correction beats a perfect calculation onto a hillside.
  • Level your SPH-2. Park it on a slope and the elevation you dialled isn't the one you get.
  • Spread is normal. Shells land in a group that widens with range — that's the weapon, not your math.
  • Everything saves automatically in your own browser. Close the tab, come back, it's still there.

Firing tables are community-measured and can change with patches. Terrain and ballistics data from the open-source wardogs-calculator project by Apollyon (MIT). Unofficial fan tool, not affiliated with BULKHEAD or Team17.
